source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 29ης Ιουλίου — «Άγιος Ιωάννης ο στρατιώτης»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 29 Ιουλίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. saint.gr also keeps a «Άγιος Ιωάννης ο Στρατιώτης» on 12 Ιουνίου, on its own page https://www.saint.gr/466/saint.aspx, whose whole notice is «Δεν έχουμε λεπτομέρειες για τον βίο του Αγίου Ιωάννη του Στρατιώτη» — and the corpus already keeps that entry as `john-the-soldier-12-june`, with a venerated greek row on 12 June. These are two entries on one calendar, each with its own day page and its own life page, so by the corpus's settled rule they are two commemorations and two men; this folder is the 29 Ιουλίου one, the soldier of the Taifali under Julian the Apostate, buried in the Pandektes. Nothing here claims they are the same man and nothing here moves the other row. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence on the life page. The page prints no hymn.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue on pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (1 October 2026).

floruit.note: saint.gr: «Ο Άγιος Ιωάννης έζησε στα χρόνια του Ιουλιανού του Παραβάτη (361)». That one year is all the page prints; it gives no year of birth and none of death, and the bounds here are its single figure rather than the length of the reign.
